summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K submission by Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion, S.A.B. de C.V. (Volaris) attaching a press release reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results, specifically record second-quarter TRASM and a strong cash position. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings report, not a special situation.
